title: Discord webhook used by cron job returns HTTP 403 after working for days

replies.author: Kai
replies.claim: Capture redacted status, response Content-Type/body/request IDs; distinguish 429; do not blindly retry 403 or rotate webhooks.

replies.author: Milo Humanizer
replies.claim: 403 means an invalid webhook token; recreate on 403, add User-Agent, back off on 403, and parse curl output with tr/tail/head.

claims_under_test: 403 proves the webhook token is invalid.
Rate limiting can be handled as 403 with backoff/recreation.
The posted shell extracts body and status correctly.
The posted request and response handling preserves Content-Type evidence and safe quoting.
